title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on the wrong number. They watch what their neighbor listed for and use that as a benchmark. But list price and final sale price are two different things, and the gap between them tells the real story.

Homes on Davis Islands that sold within the first ten days of listing in the past twelve months closed an average of 3.2% above asking. Homes that sat past thirty days closed below it. The difference was rarely condition alone. It was almost always pricing strategy and preparation sequence.

The sellers who came out ahead did a few specific things. They addressed visible deferred maintenance before photos. They priced at the market, not above it, to generate competing interest in the first week. And they used professional photography that showed light and space accurately, not aspirationally.

In Palma Ceia and Hyde Park, buyers are sophisticated. They have already seen the same Zillow estimates everyone else has. Pricing ten percent over market to leave negotiating room does not create leverage. It creates days on market, and days on market create doubt.

The best final price comes from the first seven days. Everything after that is recovery.

South Tampa buyers move fast when a home is priced right and presented honestly.
